step1.title: Effortless tracking
step1.description: Ditch the notebook. Log your sets, reps, and weights in seconds and visualize your strength gains over time.

step2.title: Smart nutrition
step2.description: Log meals in seconds with AI scanning or our massive database. Understanding your fuel is the key to peak performance.

step3.title: One app, total control
step3.description: Connect the dots between your diet and your lifts. See exactly how your nutrition fuels your strength gains with unified progress charts.

step4.title: Let's get personal
step4.description: To tailor your journey and track your gains with precision, we'd love to know a bit more about your fitness history.

personalInfo.title: Set personal information
personalInfo.trackCycleDescription: Sync your performance and nutrition with your hormonal phases.

cycleSetup.title: Cycle tracking setup
cycleSetup.description: We'll learn your cycle as you track, so you don't need to know your averages upfront.

anchor.title: Last period
anchor.description: When did your last period start? A rough guess is fine. You can update this later.

birthControl.title: Birth control
birthControl.description: Are you currently using any birth control? Hormonal methods can change how your cycle behaves.
birthControl.iudDescription: Choose hormonal or copper to be specific.
birthControl.combinedPillDescription: Daily pill with estrogen and progestin.

lifeStage.title: Cycle context
lifeStage.pcosDescription: My cycles are often irregular or unpredictable.
lifeStage.perimenopauseDescription: My cycles have become more irregular recently.
lifeStage.postpartumDescription: I gave birth in the last year.
lifeStage.postPillDescription: I stopped hormonal birth control recently and my cycle may still be adjusting.
lifeStage.noBleedingDescription: I don't have periods (for example after surgery or on suppressing hormones) but want to track how I feel.

goal.title: Sync goal
goal.description: What is your primary focus for hormonal syncing?
goal.symptomsDescription: Focus on comfort and recovery during shifts.
goal.energyDescription: Anticipate lows and adjust intensity accordingly.

pastPeriods.title: Past periods (optional)
pastPeriods.description: Adding past period start dates helps the app learn your cycle length and make better predictions right away.
pastPeriods.duplicate: That day is already on the list.

errors.futureDate: Period dates can't be in the future.
errors.overlappingPeriods: Those period dates overlap once duration is applied. Remove one or space them farther apart.

healthConnect.description: Sync your fitness data to Musclog for advanced progress tracking and personalized health insights.
healthConnect.privacyStatement: Musclog values your privacy. Your data is encrypted and used only for your personal analytics.

landing.termsAndPrivacy: By continuing, you agree to our Terms & Privacy Policy.
landing.description: Track your workouts and nutrition with complete privacy. No accounts, no cloud, no subscriptions.
landing.storedLocally: All data stored locally on your device
landing.migratingPreamble: Upgrading from the previous Musclog. We're bringing your data over.
landing.personalizedSetupSubtitle: Get accurate TDEE, macros, and personalized recommendations
landing.quickSetupSubtitle: Basic setup, you can personalize later

quickPreferences.title: Let's get started
quickPreferences.subtitle: Set your preferences for measurements and display.
quickPreferences.genderNote: Our calorie and macro formulas come from older research that only recognized two groups, so they can't reflect everyone. Pick whichever best matches your current body and hormones (for example, if you're on hormone therapy), or choose "Other" for averaged values.

quickGoals.title: What are your goals?
quickGoals.subtitle: We'll customize your experience based on these.

quickBodyStats.title: Your body stats
quickBodyStats.subtitle: Used to calculate calorie needs and track progress.
quickBodyStats.birthdayHelper: Used to calculate your age for accurate calorie estimates
quickBodyStats.bodyFatHelper: If you know it, this helps with calorie calculations

personalizedExperience.title: What's your experience?
personalizedExperience.subtitle: This helps us tailor workout suggestions to your level.
personalizedExperience.extremelyActiveDesc: Very hard exercise or physical job

personalizedCycle.title: One more question
personalizedCycle.subtitle: This helps us give you more personalized insights.

personalizedCycle.yesDesc: I'd like to track my cycle

musclogApi.title: Musclog AI
musclogApi.subtitle: Enhance your fitness journey with AI-powered insights.

coach.title: AI workout assistant
coach.desc: Get exercise suggestions and form tips

musclogApi.dataSharingBody: To provide AI features, some of your fitness data will be shared with Musclog servers. The free tier has limited requests per day.

setGoals.title: Smart goal
setGoals.description: We use the Mifflin–St Jeor and Katch–McArdle equations to estimate your metabolism, then your activity level and goals to set your calorie and macro targets.
setGoals.missingData: Please complete your fitness details first so we can calculate your plan.

trainingSetup.title: How do you train?
trainingSetup.subtitle: A few quick answers set up your gym and your first workout.

location.minimalDesc: Just your body and maybe a band

help.suggestDesc: Targets move up when you hit your reps, and the app explains why
help.manualDesc: Your plan is copied as written, nothing is changed for you

trainingSetup.changeLater: You can change all of this later in workout settings.

firstWorkout.title: Your first workout
firstWorkout.subtitlePlan: Based on your answers, this plan is a good place to start. You can edit it any time.
firstWorkout.subtitleEmpty: You can start with an empty workout and add exercises as you go.
firstWorkout.editHint: Change exercises, sets or rules whenever you like.
firstWorkout.emptyDescription: Plans in the library are built around gym equipment, so we'll skip those. Add exercises as you go, or browse plans later.
firstWorkout.stepAddBody: Search the library and add movements as you train.
firstWorkout.stepLogBody: Enter weight and reps, and the rest timer starts for you.
firstWorkout.stepNextBody: We remember your numbers and suggest your next load.
firstWorkout.planHint: Tap "{{action}}" to add this plan to your profile, or "{{later}}" to pick a workout yourself later.
